description: This Java source file defines the class RetrievePolicyIdStrategy, which handles the RetrievePolicyId command within a persistence strategy for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides logic to extract policy identifiers from 'Thing' objects and generate appropriate result objects, including error handling when the policy ID is not accessible.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyIdStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command strategy to retrieve the policy ID from a Thing object, providing result creation with success or error outcomes.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to extract the PolicyId from a Thing and constructs a Result object, either with the retrieved policy or an error if inaccessible.

methods.name: extractPolicyId
methods.description: Extracts the PolicyId from a given Thing object, throwing an exception if not available.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the optional previous EntityTag associated with the command and previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the optional next EntityTag based on the new entity's PolicyId.
